note: accords pluriannuels de développement et de fourniture de puces sur mesure jusqu'en 2031 ; montants non publiés
quote: Broadcom Inc. ("Broadcom") and Apple Inc. ("Apple") have agreed to expand their long-standing technology collaboration through 2031 by entering into new multi-year long-term agreements for Broadcom to develop and supply a range of custom ASIC silicon products for use in multiple generations of Apple products.
